title: Principal Data Analyst
description:
Job Requirements

Job Requirements

Role/ Job Title: Principal Data Analyst

Function/ Department: Data & Analytics

Job Purpose

The Principal Data Analyst plays a critical role in providing robust analytical support to the organization. They leverage data analysis, statistical modeling, machine learning methods, and optimization techniques to drive data-driven decision-making

Roles & Responsibilities

Develop and enhance business and functional requirements in collaboration with business and technology teams.
Configure interfaces to source metadata from various sources for Metadata management products.
Troubleshoot and resolve incidents related to Data Center Orchestration (DCO) tools.
Support installations and configurations of DCO, Orchestrator (OO), and Server Automation (SA) products.
Mentor peers in the use, administration, and customization of DCO team tools and applications.
Customize and extend Data Center Orchestration tools based on business requirements.
Develop automation scripts (Python, Shell, PERL, Visual Basic, batch files) for system and application administration.

Managerial And Leadership Responsibilities

Provide technical direction to the engineering team.
Collaborate with sales and client partners to develop new business and manage existing client relationships.
Contribute to thought leadership in the big data space through white papers and industry conferences.

Education Qualification

Graduation: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) / Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) / Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA)

Post-Graduation: Master of Science (M.Sc) /Master of Technology (M.Tech) / Master of Computer Applications (MCA)

Experience: 10+ years of relevant experience.

title: Data Analyst
description:
About the Role:
07
The Team: S&P Global s Private Markets Team does primary and secondary research on newly established firms and gather information of existing firms in the asset management industry, is responsible for answering client data inquiries, and works on other high value client projects. The team oversees the collection, mapping and maintenance of client, vendor and proprietary company, contact, fund, ownership, and relationship data. Team is also responsible for collecting and maintaining data which provides insight into who is holding, and investing in publicly traded securities, across the world. The data is collected from various regulatory filings, vendors, notifications or press releases and transform the raw information into usable intelligence that can give the clients a competitive edge. This data is used across multiple products by clients to facilitate transactions in the capital markets.

The Impact: In this role, you will work closely with members of our global teams, adding value to our content, as you work to ensure the highest possible levels of data quality, timeliness and completeness. You will gain invaluable insight into the areas of data collection, data analysis, and financial services. You'll be given the support and direction needed to help you succeed, while working as part of a diverse, experienced, and passionate team.

Responsibilities:

High quality data extraction, collation, and analysis for a wide range of investment plans and profiles including institutional investors, investment managers and perform client research requests.

Actively investigating asset management firms not currently included in buy-side database.

Directly communicating with investment professionals through outreach mechanisms, including calls and emails, to gather information about their investment processes.

Identifying sources and creating processes for collecting and tracking new information as needed.

Resolve internal and external client queries within timeliness.

Ideate/innovate and provide solutions for new collection methods and product/process enhancements.

Analyzing regulatory filings, prospectuses, industry publications and other sources for information pertaining to asset management firm holdings and investment information. Actively investigating asset management firms and investment professionals that are included in S&P's, buy-side database.

Communicating directly with investment professionals to obtain details on their investment process over the phone and emails.

Identifying sources and creating processes for collecting and tracking new information and verify the existing information as needed.

Analyzing regulatory filings, prospectuses, industry publications, firm websites and other sources for information pertaining to asset management firms and their investments.

Entering all changes and new information into the databases in the specified format. Communicating regularly with team leader/management/team members regarding status of projects and workload.

Requirements and skills :

MBA with specialization in finance from a reputed institute.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

At least 1 year of related work experience in data collection and research field will be preferred. Fresh graduates are also welcome to apply.

Strong listening and presentation abilities. Capability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time efficiently.

Comfortable to work in night shift, rotational shifts, and flexible hours.

Proficient numerical skills to comprehend financial data for collection and processing.

Analytical aptitude and attention to detail to ensure data accuracy.

Excellent problem solving and critical thinking skills.

Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and MS Office Suite

Knowledge of capital markets including equities and fixed income markets preferred.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Over the past 15 years, Medanta has created an unrivalled impact in delivering world class multi-specialty care for patients in India. We have hospitals in Gurgaon, Lucknow, Patna, Indore and Ranchi. In addition, we have clinics in Defence Colony (South Delhi), Cybercity & Subhash Chowk (Gurgaon), and at the Delhi Airport. Medanta is constantly growing and has also ventured in Retail vertical through Diagnostics (Laboratory Services) and Pharmacies. We also have also launched homecare services. We further plan to scale up existing facilities and expand into a few more geographical areas and also identify new avenues (Academics - Medical College) within the Healthcare eco-system. As we continue to scale and grow into new geographies, explore innovative methods of healthcare delivery, we are looking to hire exceptional talent to help us achieve our vision and grow in the process to achieve their professional aspiration.
Key Responsibilities:
Collect, clean, and analyze large datasets to generate actionable insights.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and data visualizations.
Utilize AI and machine learning algorithms to enhance data analysis and predictive modeling.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and implement data-driven solutions.
Perform statistical analysis and hypothesis testing to support strategic decisions.
Automate data collection, preprocessing, and reporting processes.
Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and security in all analytics processes.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in AI and data analytics.
Experience & Qualifications:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field.
3-6 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or related roles.
Proficiency in SQL, Python, or R for data manipulation and analysis.
Experience with AI/ML models, deep learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch), and predictive analytics.
Strong experience in visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and big data technologies (Spark, Hadoop) is a plus.
Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking abilities.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Work days: 6 days
Location: Gurgaon
